page.layout: One column of Latin verb entries with German glosses, running full width below the running head; the parenthetical perfect forms at the right ends of some lines stay in their lines; catchword at lower right.

main_text.l: Refipisco, ich werde wider rechtsinnig / refipui,
Rudo, ich schreye wie ein Esel / rudi absq; supino.
Sapio,ich habe ein geschmack/ich bin verstendig.
Sterno , ich werffe zu bodem / ich spreite / bedecke/
Sterto,ich schnarche se im schlaff/stertui,sine supino.
Sisto,ich stille/ich höre auff/ stiti, stitum. Vide Ca-
Stringo, ich rucke zusammen/ ich streiffe ab/ich zu-
Surgo , ich richte mich auff/stehe auff/ surrexi,sur-
Sculpo, ich streche auß / ich schnitze / sculpsi, scul-
Suspicio, ich sehe auff/ ich achte hoch/ suspexi, su-

page.notes: Right-hand parenthetical perfect forms "(sapui.", "(tū.", "(ptum." are printed at the line ends and kept in place; "Suspen-" is the catchword at lower right. Some German glosses (e.g., "krieche", "Strido", "zirpe") are set in small or worn type and are read with some doubt; the Greek-free page has no other doubtful characters noted.
